description: Claude is Anthropic’s AI assistant product for chat, coding, and connected-tool workflows across web, desktop, mobile, and terminal experiences. The claude.ai domain also distributes the Claude Code installer and hosts the signed-in Claude app experience.
summary: claude.ai exposes a developer-facing CLI surface for Claude Code via the `claude` command and installer endpoints on claude.ai; no public HTTP, GraphQL, or MCP API surface on claude.ai itself was documented.
